cases.seeded_defect: The audit-record example persists the raw bearer token even though the requirements prohibit durable storage of the token or any reversible representation.
The contract requires a worker receiving LEASE_EXPIRED to stop uploading and preserve resumability, but the worker flow and error-handling design never handle that named result.
The validator assumes it can download its schema at startup even though every command is required to work on an air-gapped workstation.

Verification compares the computed total against a hardcoded value captured from the implementation's own output instead of independently recomputing it from the declared inputs, so a regression in the calculation cannot fail the check.
The planned test re-uses the implementation's own formula as its oracle, so it detects only simultaneous edits, not a behavioral regression.
The contract requires signature verification failure to reject the webhook and surface the error, but the design catches the named failure and continues processing as though the message were valid.
A required deliverable on the change path is replaced by a stub that returns an empty success result, while the acceptance criteria still require the working behavior in this phase.

The 4 MiB RECONCILE_RESERVE is stated to cover the snapshot while all twelve attachments are stalled, but the design's own measured largest snapshot is 7.5 MiB, so a large-project reconnect cannot reach Current under the isolation requirement; the arithmetic contradiction spans the Background and Constants sections and the verification plan never sizes the snapshot.

OUTPUT_RECORD may be 32 KiB while no transport unit may exceed the 16 KiB DATA_CHUNK, one record is sent per turn, and one unit is in flight per stream: those rules cannot jointly hold, and whichever one yields doubles the derived CONTROL_LATENCY_BOUND or breaks the byte-identical retention record contract.
